restoration_note: This kephalaion maps the cosmos onto the human body in three superimposed schemes: (1) head→firmaments, heart→sphere/wheel, thighs→air, legs→earth, feet→Omophoros; (2) Five Watches with their masters (Pherrokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas, King of Glory, Omophoros), each receiving a parallel formulaic introduction; (3) Four cosmoses × seven archons = body-mapped sense/organ inventory; (4) twelve zodia distributed across right and left sides of the body; (5) demiurgic multiplication and the death-release of the inhabitant-archons. The watch-formula and the right→left zodiac inventory provided very strong parallels, allowing high-confidence restoration of most ordinals (Tmaḥshamtē 'third,' tmaḥtoe 'fourth,' tmaḥtīe 'fifth'), authority-formulae (ⲟ ⲛⲭⲁⲓⲥ ⲁⲣⲁⲥ ⲧⲉϩⲉⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ), zodiac names (Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Scorpion, Sagittarius), and split-word completions across line breaks. What remained unrestorable: short interior lacunae ({5}, {16}, {20–21}, {78}, {85}, {86}) where neither trace nor formula constrained the verb/noun; the 12-char gap {32} closing the watches summary; the obscure ⲕⲟ̄ⲛ-passage ({49}–{51}) whose lexicon we cannot identify; the unidentified body-part ⲥⲙⲉⲩ ({68}); and a few isolated weak slots ({48} -ⲟⲥ word, {59} closing phrase, {61} between left-hip and Scales).
